documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong start to FY27 with 27% year-on-year revenue growth and a 55% jump in EBITDA, driven by robust performance in construction equipment and new business wins. Management highlighted that the restoration of the Ludhiana facility is on schedule and Mexico warehouse operations are on track for Q3 customer deliveries. While large agricultural equipment remains at a cyclical bottom, construction equipment momentum and new business wins support a positive outlook for the fiscal year. The balance sheet remains healthy with a net cash position of INR190 crores, and the company continues to actively evaluate inorganic acquisition opportunities. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 3,474 million and total income of INR 3,552 million, alongside EBITDA of INR 898 million and PAT of INR 566 million.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: I think overall on an annual basis, what we are seeing is that the growth of the construction industry is faster than what was envisaged at the start of the year. And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q2 performance is projected to be in line with Q1.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects sequential performance in Q1 to be in line with Q4.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the U.S. and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicated that calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, with recovery expected in calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India continues to perform well due to government subsidies and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket business represented approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: India continues to perform well in the small agriculture segment, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of 26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirm that quarter 4 of 26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations remain on track for first customer deliveries from the warehouse in Q3 of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR12 crores for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering a 55% increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was about 33.3%, driven largely by product mix changes.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross profit margin for Q1 FY27 was 66.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6% 64.7% 65.6%

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management has consistently stated that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability was impacted by INR3.4 crores due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, supported by a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: A special dividend of INR 101 crore was declared in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to some demand skewing and moderation of purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases in Western small agriculture markets has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the company's facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful vertical within the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
